401358066c7a83e2dca0.title: Customer Support Specialist, Tier 1 - Part-time
401358066c7a83e2dca0.description:
#### **About Gradient**

Join us at Gradient, where our purpose is to revolutionize home comfort while championing environmental sustainability. Our mission is to combat the escalating challenge of climate change by redefining how homes are heated and cooled. Today, the environmental impact of heating and cooling systems surpasses that of the entire transportation sector, and without intervention, this trend is set to escalate drastically.

At Gradient, we believe that ensuring comfortable living spaces shouldn’t come at the cost of our planet. We envision a future where every individual can enjoy the luxury of a comfortable home without contributing to carbon emissions. Our high-efficiency, low-carbon heat pump is just the beginning of our journey toward fully decarbonizing buildings.

By joining Gradient, you’ll be at the forefront of a movement to make sustainable living accessible to all, ensuring healthier communities and a brighter, greener future.

##### **About the Role**

As a **Part-Time Customer Support Specialist, Tier 1**, you'll be one of the first human points of contact for Gradient customers who need help with their product or experience.

You'll work within Gradient's Customer Experience team to respond to customer questions, gather the right information, follow established support procedures, and make sure issues reach the appropriate next step. You'll also help oversee an increasingly automated support experience—reviewing automated interactions, identifying when something doesn't look right, and helping us understand where our processes and tools can improve.

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who enjoys helping people, communicates clearly, and is comfortable learning new systems. You don't need a technical or HVAC background. We'll provide the procedures and product knowledge you need to succeed.

**Compensation:** The anticipated hourly rate for this role is $25.00-$27.00 per hour. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications, and location.

**Location: Remote, U.S.-based. Approximately 20 hours per week.**

The anticipated schedule is approximately **Wednesday through Sunday, with regular weekend coverage and working hours aligned primarily with Eastern Time customer needs.** Exact hours may be adjusted based on business needs and candidate availability.

##### **Responsibilities**

* Serve as a frontline point of contact for customers across email and, as Gradient expands its channels, phone and SMS.
* Respond to routine customer questions using established procedures, macros, support content, and approved workflows.
* Gather required customer and product information before escalating technical issues to Tier 2.
* Review automated customer-support interactions for accuracy and identify situations requiring human intervention.
* Flag incorrect, incomplete, or confusing automated responses and provide feedback to help improve Gradient's support processes.
* Recognize issues that fall outside Tier 1 procedures and route them appropriately to Tier 2.
* Maintain clear and accurate customer and case records in Zendesk and other support systems.
* Communicate calmly and professionally with customers, including customers who may be frustrated or concerned.
* Help ensure customers receive timely follow-up and understand what will happen next.
* Learn Gradient's products and support processes as they evolve.
* Partner closely with the Tier 2 Technical Support Specialist and Customer Experience team.

##### **Desired Qualifications**

* Some experience working directly with customers, whether through customer service, retail, hospitality, restaurants, call centers, administrative work, or another customer-facing environment.
* Clear and professional written and verbal communication.
* Comfort speaking with customers by phone.
* Patience and empathy when working with frustrated customers.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established processes consistently.
* Good judgment about when something doesn't look right and needs to be escalated.
* Comfortable learning and working in multiple software systems.
* Reliable, organized, and able to work independently in a remote environment.
* Availability for approximately 20 hours per week, including regular weekend coverage.

##### **Bonus Qualifications**

* Previous customer support or contact-center experience.
* Experience with Zendesk or another ticketing/customer support platform.
* Experience working with automated customer-service tools, chatbots, or AI-assisted workflows.
* Experience supporting consumer products, hardware, appliances, or technology.
* Spanish/English bilingual proficiency.
* Interest in growing into more technical customer support responsibilities over time.
* Interest in climate technology or home electrification.

##### **Benefits**

* Equity
* Medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance
* 401k
* Paid parental leave
* Professional Development Stipend
* Commuter benefits
* Flexible PTO

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive company. We seek to create a culture where everyone can belong because we believe that people do their best work when they can show up every day as their authentic selves. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives.

Gradient is an equal opportunity employer. We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law.

0fa90c57a38d2d524b3d.title: Senior Product Manager
0fa90c57a38d2d524b3d.description:
BitPay is building blockchain technology that transforms how businesses and people send, receive, and store money. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the shared infrastructure that powers BitPay's merchant acceptance and consumer wallet products, including the blockchain networks and tokens we support, the partners we integrate with, and the core services that move, hold, and verify money.

As a Senior Product Manager at BitPay, you will work across departments to ensure that internal stakeholders' needs are reflected in your product roadmap. You will collaborate closely with senior leadership to define and refine requirements for mission-critical platform initiatives, ensuring alignment with the company’s strategic objectives. Your role will bridge gaps between teams, foster collaboration, and drive the success of our platform and the products it supports.

### **Requirements:**

* Own the platform roadmap and the full product lifecycle, from discovery through launch and iteration, for services used by the Acceptance and Wallet products.

* Define and deliver core money-movement capabilities, including real-time payouts, custody, payroll, and cross-chain transactions.
* Partner with Compliance to design risk-based KYC, KYB, and transaction monitoring for businesses and consumers, balancing regulatory requirements with conversion.
* Take new products and material changes through regulatory review. Prepare product documentation, funds-flow diagrams, and risk assessments, and present them to regulators and auditors as the product subject-matter expert.

* Hands-on experience shipping payment infrastructure, such as payouts, settlement, money movement, or ledgering.
* A track record of leading third-party integrations with partners or vendors, from evaluation through production launch.
* Experience building products in regulated financial services, including KYC/KYB, AML, and transaction monitoring, and working directly with compliance teams, regulators, or auditors.
* The technical depth to write precise requirements, read API documentation, reason about system design trade-offs, and earn engineers' trust.
* A consistent practice of defining requirements before development begins and keeping engineering work tied to them.
* Strong written communication. You can explain complex funds flows, risks, and trade-offs to executives, engineers, and regulators.
* A data-driven approach, with experience using SQL or analytics tools to monitor platform health and adoption.
* The ability to work independently and own outcomes across multiple teams with competing priorities.
* Proficiency in Atlassian (Jira, Confluence), Google Workspace, and user analytics tools.

Takes the appropriate action marking delivery as received if the product was physically delivered, contacting vendor for past undelivered scheduled receipts, and opening tickets as needed to correct inaccurate orders.

Facilitates excess inventory returns or interstore pharmacy transfers where applicable for non-returnable ABC overstock. Verifies posting of all pharmacy/ prescription claims.

* Maintains accurate inventory counts. Maintains the accuracy of on-hand quantities including but not limited to basic departments, stockroom, overstock locations.

* Knowledgeable of all store systems and equipment.
* Assists and coaches store team on all package delivery activities, including scanning in and out of packages, completing all daily inventory functions and, package returns at Walgreens. Supports execution of Pickup Program.
* In designated stores, when serving as the leader on duty, responsible and accountable for registering all related sales on assigned point-of-sale system (POS), including records of scanning errors, price verifications, items not on file, price modifications, and voids. Completes product returns, order voids, customer refunds, cash drops to safe, and provides change as requested for point of sale.

**Training & Personal Development**

When serving as the leader on duty, communicates assigned tasks to team members and reports disciplinary issues and customer complaints to management.

860947d00274f694dcb5.title: High Level Bookkeepper
860947d00274f694dcb5.description:
**Senior Bookkeeper — Construction Accounting**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Bookkeeper with strong knowledge of QuickBooks Online, cost accounting, and the construction/contracting industry. This position manages day-to-day bookkeeping, maintains accurate financial records, and provides reliable job-cost and financial reporting to support project profitability.

The ideal candidate can independently manage full-cycle bookkeeping, identify discrepancies, and work closely with owners, project managers, vendors, subcontractors, and the company’s outside accountant.

Job is in person with some remote work allowed. Does require a possible once a week trip to Norristown, PA.

English speaking but ability to speak Spanish a plus but not required.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage full-cycle bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger entries, and account reconciliations.
* Maintain accurate construction job-cost records by project, cost code, and expense category.
* Track and allocate labor, materials, subcontractor costs, equipment expenses, and overhead.
* Compare actual project costs with budgets, investigate variances, and report on project profitability.
* Process vendor invoices and subcontractor payments, ensuring proper approval and project coding.
* Prepare customer invoices, progress billings, and retainage schedules; monitor collections and outstanding balances.
* Track change orders and ensure approved changes are reflected in billing and project budgets.
* Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, loans, and other balance sheet accounts.
* Complete month-end closing and prepare financial statements, job-cost reports, and cash-flow summaries.
* Coordinate payroll processing and accurately allocate payroll costs to jobs.
* Maintain subcontractor documentation, including W-9 forms, insurance certificates, and lien waivers, as applicable.
* Support work-in-progress reporting and coordinate accounting adjustments with the company’s outside accountant.
* Prepare records for year-end reporting, 1099 preparation, tax filings, and audits.
* Improve bookkeeping procedures, internal controls, and the accuracy of financial reporting.

**Required Qualifications**

* Five or more years of progressively responsible bookkeeping or accounting experience, including experience in the construction industry.
* Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online.
* Strong understanding of cost accounting, construction job costing, and full-cycle bookkeeping.
* Experience with progress billing, retainage, subcontractor accounting, and change orders.
* Ability to independently reconcile accounts, resolve discrepancies, and complete month-end closing.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, spreadsheets, and financial analysis.
* Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple deadlines.
* Strong communication skills and sound judgment when handling confidential financial information.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Preferred Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Preferred QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification.
* Experience with construction management software and accounting integrations.
* Familiarity with work-in-progress schedules, AIA billing, certified payroll, and prevailing wage projects.

**Success in This Role**

Success means accurate and timely financial records, dependable job-cost reporting, efficient billing and collections, and clear insight into project costs, cash flow, and profitability.

Pay: $20.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 24.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Retirement plan

Language:

* Spanish (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Reading, PA 19610
